question.prompt: Two high school classes took the same test. One class of \(20\) students made an average grade of \(80\%\); the other class of \(30\) students made an average grade of \(70\%.\) The average grade for all students in both classes is:

solutions.explanation:
Each student's grade must count once, so the two class averages receive weights equal to their class sizes. Expressing all grades on a \(100\)-point scale, the first class has total score \(20\cdot80=1600\), and the second has total score \(30\cdot70=2100\).

There are \(20+30=50\) students, so their combined average is
\[
\frac{1600+2100}{50}
=\frac{3700}{50}=74.
\]
Thus the average grade is \(74\%\), choice B.
solutions.title: Combine the score totals
